documents.unit: Division of Information Resources & Technology and Office of the Provost
documents.title: Artificial Intelligence Policy (University Policies)
documents.quality_note: Official university policy but about data security: non-public Rowan data may not go into unapproved AI tools; university business only in approved platforms. Says nothing on student coursework beyond that.

documents.title: Generative Artificial Intelligence & Teaching
documents.quality_note: States the university has no universal generative AI policy and gives sample syllabus statements (prohibit through permit) tied to the Academic Integrity Policy; rest is resource links.

documents.title: GenAI at Rowan: For Students
documents.quality_note: Student-facing: using GenAI without instructor permission may be an academic integrity violation; lists approved tools. Few rule sentences.

documents.title: Generative AI Use Policy
documents.date_or_term: cites AI tools accessed June-July 2025; no explicit date
documents.quality_note: Full departmental policy: appropriate and inappropriate uses, citation format with examples, procedure for suspected unauthorized use (oral/written justification).

notes: No university-wide academic-use AI policy exists (Faculty Center says so). Rowan CS department and College of Science & Mathematics searched; no unit policy found. Seed URL was a single instructor's course syllabus (deferred layer), not collected. Recheck (D36) added: rowan-ece-genai-policy.
